Checking Sepolia contracts… SqueekCore ↗ Score contract ↗

Shared challenges use an immutable snapshot of recorded hardware passages from the Squeekchain API: everyone gets the same seed, obstacles and speed timeline. Each passage interval maps to 1.1 / interval seconds rad/s, clamped to 0.55–1.4 and smoothed at 120 Hz. This is a game rule, not a physical simulation. Live mode freezes on idle, errors, stale data or an epoch change.

The server recomputes shared scores from your Space inputs. Replay checking limits score tampering; it does not prevent bots or prove who played. Saving onchain writes a server-attested game score to the Squeek Run score contract on Sepolia (test ETH for gas). It is not SqueekCore-certified physical work. Wallet support: regular EOA wallets only.
